rules.name: ARTEX backend binary artifacts (Xint)

rules.limitations: Binary file signature only; authorized ARTEX fork or upstream binaries can match. This does not prove misuse or exploitation.

rules.name: ARTEX embedded web console markers (Xint)

rules.limitations: Legacy ARTEX web UI strings may appear in legitimate installations, backups or documentation.

rules.name: ARTEX prompt and transcript markers (Xint)
rules.author: Xint

rules.name: ARTEX tool-schema strings (Xint)
rules.author: Xint
rules.limitations: Common function names can overlap in unrelated tools and logs. Require corroborating artifacts.

rules.name: ARTEX session transcript artifacts (Xint)
rules.author: Xint
rules.limitations: Offline JSON/JSONL transcript heuristics only; authorized tests and archived exports may match.

rules.name: ARTEX API reconnaissance skill scripts (Xint)

rules.limitations: Script constants identify installed or copied tools; authorized assessments can match.

rules.name: ARTEX legacy supervisor script (Xint)
rules.author: Xint
rules.limitations: Legacy self-update marker may not match current versions; authorized installations and copied scripts can match.

rules.name: Norma SDK binary fingerprint (Xint)
rules.author: Xint
rules.limitations: Generic Norma SDK, not ARTEX-specific. A match alone is not an attack indicator.

rules.name: go-mitmproxy recorder binary fingerprint (Xint)
rules.author: Xint
rules.limitations: Any go-mitmproxy integration can match, including legitimate test and proxy tooling.

rules.name: go-mitmproxy CA certificate artifact (Xint)
rules.author: Xint
rules.limitations: A certificate signed or generated for a legitimate local proxy may match. Not unique to ARTEX.
